children: MegaETH is scheduled to unlock up to 382.9 million MEGA on 30 Apr 2027 for investors and public sale buyers. The maximum unlock amount is equivalent to 33.89% of the token's circulating supply.

The unlock gives recipients the ability to sell the released tokens. A release of this size creates a large potential supply overhang and can put pressure on the price if investors and public sale buyers sell.

title: MegaETH: Unlocks up to 382.9 million MEGA - 30 Apr 2027
